newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR YUGOSLAVIA V SPAIN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR YUGOSLAVIA V SPAIN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Teams for the World Cup group six qualifier between Yugoslavia and Spain on Wednesday:

Yugoslavia - 1-Ivica Kralj, 2-Zoran Mirkovic, 3-Goran Djorovic, 4-Risto Vidakovic, 5-Miroslav Djukic, 6-Sinisa Mihajlovic, 7-Dejan Govedarica, 8-Dejan Savicevic, 9-Predrag Mijatovic, 10-Dragan Stojkovic, 11-Ljubinko Drulovic.

Spain - 1-Andoni Zubizaretta, 2-Abelardo Fernandez, 3-Sergi Barjuan, 4-Rafael Alkorta, 5-Miguel Nadal, 6-Fernando Hierro, 7-Kiko Narvaez, 8-Roberto Rios, 9-Josep Guardiola, 10-Raul Gonzales, 11-Perez Alfonso.
